cell.label: Patient presents with acute swelling at or near a joint.
History of chronic pain and/or steroid injections in that area, or history of fluroquinolone use?
Sudden onset of sharp pain with signs of tendon rupture (unable to flex or extend the joint, balled up muscles, or palpable gap in the tendon?
Tendon rupture; refer to orthopedic surgeon.
Suspect tendinopathy or peritendonitis; consider ultrasound or MRI.
Suspect sprain, fracture, or ligament tear. Take X-rays and ligament tests.
